summary_md: **theaitechnolog ([@theaitechnolog](https://x.com/theaitechnolog/status/2116084245462655186))** highlights **Qwenputer**, which compiles an exact RISC-V CPU into Qwen 3.5 4B's weights so it runs C and Python internally without tool calls, executing 18M instructions error-free; a follow-up cites 97.5% versus 72.5% on big division, single 24 GB GPU, and the author's 'experiment' caveat ([divagr18/qwenputer](https://github.com/divagr18/qwenputer)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - divagr18/qwenputer: A computer, compiled into the weights of a language model. An exact CPU inside Qwen3.5-4B, with Gated DeltaNet state as RAM.

relevance: Striking research toy on computation compiled into model weights.
